locators.satz: When comparison was only made between 2 groups (no cooling vs mild cooling; no cooling vs deep cooling and mild cooling vs deep cooling), it seems that the mild-cooling-treated patients fared better than no cooling (70% of mild cooling attained good GOS compared with only 15.4% attained good GOS in no cooling group, *P* = 0.013); and apparently, the deep-cooling-treated patients failed to be better than either no cooling (*P* = 0.074) or mild cooling group (*P* = 0.650).
